gloss_en: the 'shields of the generation' (maginey eretz, 'shields of the earth,' Ps. 47:10) — the protective tzaddikim of the generation who shield and save the people by closing and subduing the seal of the Sitra Achra formed through pride/lust (per Job 41:7)
canonical_he: המגנים שבדור. כי יש מגני ארץ
